name: destinationPath
label: Destination folder
help: An existing folder, for example `archive/2026/`. Leave it empty for the root of the bucket. Create the folder first if it does not exist.

name: conflict
label: If the name is taken
help: What to do when an item with the same name is at the destination: "Fail" stops with an error and moves nothing, "Rename" moves it as "name (1)", and "Skip" leaves that item where it is.
